text:
zara_sales: Hey team — GovFin wants a POC: EU-only for normal ops, automatic APAC failover only on verified outage. They need: 1) a copyable routing snippet, 2) APAC subprocessor list for failover, 3) how BYOK/KMS behaves, 4) rough cost delta for cross-region egress. Need answers for their security questionnaire by Tue.

drew_infra: cc @pat_sre @ira_security. Yes — we support region_preferred + manual failover gate. Caveats: cold cache on APAC and some metrics/logs may show APAC collectors during failover.

drew_infra: Snippet (yaml):
```yaml
routing_policy: region_preferred
primary: eu-west-1
fallbacks: [ap-southeast-1]
failover_trigger: regional_health == DOWN && control_plane_ack == true
audit: enabled
```

pat_sre: Ops notes for runbook:
- Recommend healthcheck TTL 45s.
- Run chaos partition: simulate eu outage and verify routing flip.
- Bandwidth example: baseline 600GB/mo -> worst-case failover extra ~480GB cross-region while caches rebuild.

ira_security: Subprocessors (APAC failover): GCP Compute (ap-southeast-1), AWS EC2/EBS (ap-northeast-1), Datadog for telemetry. Full annex will be attached to questionnaire.

ira_security: KMS/BYOK: BYOK can be pinned to EU KMS. During failover we proxy unwrap calls to EU KMS so key material remains in EU; this adds cross-region latency (~150-250ms). If customer forbids any cross-region KMS calls, we can restrict failover to cached responses only or require manual approval.

zara_sales: Perfect. Can someone draft a single-paragraph answer I can paste into their security questionnaire?

ira_security: Paste-ready text: "Redwood will apply a region_preferred routing policy for the GovFin POC. Production traffic is served from EU compute; APAC regions serve only when EU is verified unhealthy and failover is authorized. Subprocessors in APAC (standard cloud compute and telemetry providers) are listed in our subprocessor annex. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) can be pinned to EU KMS; decrypt/unwrap calls during failover are proxied to EU KMS so key material is not exposed outside the EU. All failover activations, routing decisions, and KMS operations are recorded in audit logs and customers receive notifications."

drew_infra: Pricing note: brief failover (<5% traffic) -> negligible incremental egress (~$0.01-$0.03/GB). Sustained failover -> expect ~25-40% cost uplift. We can produce a tailored PDF.

pat_sre: I'll add a short runbook and chaos test commands to the shared drive and ping when done.

deploy-bot: deploy 2501-govfin-eu-pref-poc -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark: (tag: ppc-eu-hot-standby)

zara_sales: Thanks all — I'll send the questionnaire answers and the yaml to GovFin and flag any follow-ups here.
